note: Answer key for the seeded accessibility lab. 'axeRule' is the axe-core rule expected to catch the issue, or null when automated rules cannot (these are where human or AI review adds value).

issues.description: Light grey text on white fails contrast.
Input labelled only by a placeholder. axe accepts a placeholder as an accessible name, but it disappears while typing.
Text input with no label or placeholder at all.
Icon-only button with no accessible name.
Link containing only a decorative icon.
Heading jumps from h1 to h4.
Clickable span acting as a button: not focusable or keyboard operable.
Link text 'Click here' is ambiguous out of context.
Meaning conveyed by colour alone (red = down).
Visual order (Step 1 above Step 2) differs from DOM/focus order.
